official_definition: Flash - Absolute Sound Speed (Either Attack Step) You can summon this card from your Hand by including 20px when paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Absolute Sound Speed] or [Absolute Sound Speed: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Absolute Sound Speed]", "give [Absolute Sound Speed]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
